title: TRAIN SNAKE
oneLiner: Grow a mighty train by collecting cargo while avoiding your own winding cars!
mechanics: Steer the locomotive around one screen and collect cargo crates.
Each crate adds a train car to your tail and scores points.
Avoid walls and colliding with your own train cars.
The train moves faster and cargo appears more often over time.
lose: You lose when the locomotive hits the border or any train car.
scoring: Collecting each cargo crate scores points and lengthens the train.
